description: Index an .mbox file (Google Takeout, Thunderbird) or a directory of .eml files — entirely locally, nothing leaves the machine. Returns message count, date range, and top senders. Large archives are indexed once and cached.

path.description: Path to an .mbox file (e.g. a Google Takeout export) or a directory of .eml files

name: open_archive
title: Open a local email archive
